content:
A poster appears:
Mayoral Race sign ups. All nominees must be seconded by at least two other players.
(Say Fae wants to run. She would say  <@&636744896287342602> I’d like to announce my candidacy for Mayor. And then have two friends type <@&636744896287342602> I nominate Fae. A serverwide @everyone will follow and be pinned to the #politics_channel). Anyone may add their name to the race at any time. However, it would be advantageous to your campaign to decide early enough for the debates wednesday and thursday. Voting will begin thursday evening in the facebook group as a poll. It will not be tallied until Friday just before the main event. The Mayor will assume their role after the event.
Also, submit your questions for the debate.
(question, can we announce, and the friends support later?  or does it need to be roughly the same time)
(are we limited by how many we can support/nominate?)
Each player may only nominate one other player. And you must already have support to post.
(so if we know we have the support, we can post, and let them second it when they get on?)
<@&636744896287342602> I nominate Sandigill
QUESTION: "What are your goals concerning relations with the tribes of Arcania?"
<@&636744896287342602> I'd like to announce my candidacy for mayor
<@&636744896287342602> I second Sandigill for mayor, (I know I don't have a character rn but yeah,)
<@&636744896287342602> I’d like to announce my candidacy for mayor
<@&636744896287342602> I second the incredible leader Copper for the position of mayor <:Copper4Mayor:738886602041983057>
<@&636744896287342602> I nominate Copper for mayor.
(This particular comment didn’t age well upon realizing the amount of debt copper is in <@!366565198284324868> )
<@&636744896287342602> I nominate my husband, Cato Zephyr, for mayor.
I second Cato Zephyr for Mayor.
Cato is officially running. He would hold a meeting at the tree house around 6 (unless we have an event)
enters the house, moving some chairs into a triangle and sits and waits with his book in his lap
Ophelia stays back out of sight until they enter the building then find a place to listen.
Cato enters the mayors house
smiles at cato and motions to the chairs "I think its best if we sit as three equals"
He nods his head
"now we wait for copper.  how did things go last night?"
"Baeshra has returned. Web is still in danger though."
"We need Daysong"
thinks "do we know where daysong is?  roughly?  is he captured or missing?"
"Missing in the woods is all we know. Hopefully I can help lead a search party for him tonight."
"you need our friends castor and Rigatony.... who is our best tracker?"
"Castor and Goose were a part of it. 🎵 is quite good at tracking through the woods. I would like Rigatoni as well..."

nod "at this point.... you need a couple trackers.... and our best warriors.... i dont think diplomacy will do anything as I think youd have found him if locals had him"  thinks "you might see about Fabertell.... his illusions may come in handy"
(Ooc Fabertell is retired)
(didnt know)
"I am afraid they have their hands full tith the bees."
(Yeah they wanted to try a different play style. They are now bee keeper npc)
(i wonder if i need to sponsor a differant merchant now)
(I believe the new chracter is still a merchant)
Copper walks over
"Welcome friend." Cato gestures to the chair next to him (sc0ut)
motions to the open chair "so... I have given much thought.... and have something I would like to say... and see how you feel"
Copper takes the seat “sounds good to me, I am open to hear what you have to say mi friend”
(Come on city council) 🤞
(Im saying this right now cause gil might offend you guys... once I have said my peace, I grant PVP up to and including if we need a DM to monitor you killing me)

saying without hint of malice, but with much concern. “Each of us have strengths and weaknesses that need addressed, and personal reflection.  Cato” he looks addresses Cato “you desire power.  You desire to lord over people….  You desire to control.” Pauses a moment “You asked… and bragged about wanting to be Copper’s second…. My second… and now that you have gotten married, you are using your family to secure votes for you to be mayor……. You are hedging all bets… you desire power…. Just look… you married nobility just so you could gain the title… rumor was you forgot your spouse completely…. And within 2 days found love again and married and was granted noble title…. I am sorry my friend… but to me that appears to speak volumes for your underlying desire to gain … No one who has power should want it…. But your drive, your desire, there inlays your great strengths…. You are one of our fiercest warriors, with a tactical mind, and brave heart…. You have great intuition…. You fight for your fellows and their loss weighs on your soul…. You protect them…. You will fight tooth and nail for us…. You would be a great leader analyzing our defenses… and managing our explorations…. Simply put…. You can see the weak spots we need to shore up, and the weaknesses of our enemies… You would be an amazing battle leader.”

looks to copper “Copper…. you a beloved by all…. everyone’s friend.  You can rally the people behind any cause.  They follow you out of love not fear…. You have the peoples respect…. “pauses a moment to think things through “you do not desire power, but your loved ones will follow you into the deepest pits in the nine hells…. you are also kind hearted… and your love for others… I believe… will make it difficult for you to stand in judgement over them…. And will make it difficult for you to order them to their deaths…. Even if their deaths would save the colony as a whole….  If Leaf… if I… offend locals… and their laws call for our blood to prevent war… could you order leaf or me to our deaths?  Or would you try to barter for them… possibly accept your life instead?”  shakes his head “You are my friend…. Those decisions… even if you could make…. Would weigh down on your soul.”  Pauses “you don’t have the fortitude to accept that your position may require you to sacrifice those you hold most dear….. and you have to be able to put your need and desires below that of the colony….”
(Lol thats why Ophelia is here listening outside)

waits a moment “as for me….. my friends say… I listen…. I am wise…. And I am fair….. I understand what people need…. And I fix problems without asking for anything, even thanks….” Waits a moment “These traits make me good for judging… and managing for the needs of us all…. I devoted my life to serving others…. Even at the expense of myself.”  Waits a moment “but I am not loved…. I am respected by some… but I do not have the love of the people.  I will never be listened to like Copper…. I will never be respected like him…. And I will not ever be listened to like people listen to him….. Likewise… I am not a warrior…. I am weak…. My magics are for protection and healing…. not battle….. I don’t have the battlefield leadership…. Nor the understanding…. That Cato has.  Copper is good in a fight… but Cato…. You could disembowel me with your bare hands…. and think nothing of it tomorrow….”

“I believe you can see what I am suggesting…. Instead of us contending against each other…. Why don’t we unite.  Split the job 3 ways…. Defenses and battle” motions to Cato “… Leading the workers and rallying the people behind causes” motions to copper “…. And I settle disputes…. Judge those brought to justice… and work to figure out what solutions are needed for the problems that arise….  This also means that on major issues…. We three can vote….. and thus manage the colony with a majority vote… rather than an iron fist….  3 people…. Who are placed where they are strongest…. Running the colony.  A triumvirate in your terms… that’s my idea on how we do this….. I, Baron Sandigill, Eldest Chinnokin of the Roanoak Colony and Priest of the Twin Vents School, Member of the Mid Atlantic Nation Chinnokin, would be honored to serve alongside the both of you in this fashion.”
(end of speach... pvp granted til we leave the house if need be)

Copper leans over, and pokes Sandigil, “my friend, you are too tense.”
(I’m not gonna fight you :p)
nods to copper
Cato is still stuck on his desire to lord over people. He is genuinely hurt in this moment. And also hur that Sandigill brought up his memories again.
(now you know why i granted PVP)
"I did not marry nobility just for the title. You have the wrong impression of me"
(He would never)
Gil keeps quiet, allowing copper and cato to digest and respond... knowing full well his words may have hurt his friends

"I do not care for the title. I am no duke. Simply Cato. I am not here for the power. I am here to represent those who lack a voice. I am here for Skitter, so he knows someone he can trust is watching over the town. Moreso then my ability as a worrior. I am a protector. The vangaurd. A paragon. I accept your offer as I believe I will be useful in the role. But I hope you reconsider who you think I am as a person. Not for the sake of the council. But because I want to be your friend."
nods to cato and says "us working togeather in this fashion will build a bond deeper than trust I feel" looks to Copper

“My friend, in all honesty I have considered some of the same things you have. We each have our strengths and weaknesses, that when work together, may be able to help where each other lacks.” He pauses for a moment. “However a few people have raised some concerns to me about the both of you. Some fear either of you gaining power. It’s worried that even if we do form a council, the voice of the serfs will be drowned out by the aristocrats.” He looks to them both, “this concern is not my own, but it was one that was asked of me, so I bring it it here to be discussed.”
"I serve the people. I have been one of you my entire life. I will not forget the daily struggle Copper"

"then I can renounce my title.  It all comes down to this.... we can go against eachother, and have leadership lacking.... or we can unite.  That said... if people dont want me having power, I can remove my name from the race.  I want no power, and at one point you didnt either Copper.  I only want to serve"
"You lead the people for the struggle of the warehouse. That is still important Sandigill"
"Thanks to you we may still eat"
"I paid, and raised awareness... much like we need people to work on the town walls now.... Copper did the work"
"I saw a problem needing fixed.... he got the people behind it"
"our strengths"

Copper nods, “I propose an idea. The council will be a great idea, but it can slow down progress. If every decision needs to be voted on, it will take forever for us to make each decision. With that said, having each of us voting would keep each other in check when we make a mistake.”
He looks to them both, “I propose we have a head Mayor. Someone that can make the decisions for the small stuff without needing a vote. The big decisions will be left to votes, while the smaller day to day decisions can be taken care of by the head mayor. How would you guys feel about that?”
"Agreed. I nominate Sandigill to be head."
looks startled

"what about this.... Cato is our general.... in charge of everything defense related.... Copper mayor.... in charge of the people and moral.... me judge.... in charge of hearing all grievances and judging crimes.... each has authority over their area.... and laws and policies we vote on.  If Cato needs help with defenses, he lets copper know, copper gets the people to aid.... we only need to vote to change the rules and laws in the charter... otherwise, we split the responsibility those ways"
“As much as I think that that is a good idea, I think the head mayor position should still be voted on by the people. If we just declare one of us to be in power, some may come to resent that.”
"I shall widraw from running for the title. Being on the council is enough for me. I.. am *not* here for power."

"you would present it to the people as their best intrest..... lets say you are head mayor, and I judge... that gives you the athority to favorite your friends and annul justice.... putting one above the others makes the others position meaningless... only as equals can we be fair"
"Then we ask them to vote on what we decided today? They still need a voice."
Copper nods “I think that would be a good idea”

"I will say this... Copper... you will win any vote based on popularity.  So you have to be the one that makes them believe in this.  My supporters are dead (or retired) for the most part.... and if i lose... I will still help.  Cato.. you have the love of your family... but I still think the vote goes to Copper.... We have to get everyone behind this.... or the colony will perish as past ones have.... One man cannot rule... no matter what the nobles think"

"We need to hold a meeting with the people. We invite them here to grill us on what we are doing. I think then we will find better answers on how to proceed. This has given us a good starting point though."
"copper.... are you in agreement.... or do you wish to have all the power over town yourself?"
"That isn't fair."
"none of this is fair... .service isnt fair... "

Copper looks to Sandigil, “I’ll talk to the people who I know will be most against this idea. I will hear what they have to say of it, and there concerns from it. From there, I think we’d be able to see how to best make a council work for the people.”

a bit more firmly "what do you personally think is best... a single lord over the town, or split power.... if you dont believe in this... then there is no point in us continueing the discussion of a split"

“I believe the idea for a council could potentially work best; but I also think some of us are blind to some aspects we cannot see. Which is why I wish to hear the concerns of it. To make sure to cover those problems we do not know of it.”
"so you are neither for or against it... using double speak to not commit..."
“My apologies, that is not my intention”
"I ask you what YOU believe... "
"if you dont believe it... you will not get the people behind it.  so it becomes pointless"

“I have said that I believe the idea, I just wish to hear the concerns of it. I believe it can work, I just also want to hear if people have a problem with it. How can I convince people of it, if I don’t know what there concerns are? I need to understand what they question, so that I may answer them. If I am to convince them that I believe this decision to be best, I need to know what they worry about most.”
"But do you WANT it to work?"
“Yes, I very much do. Which is why I want to hear both sides of the decision. So as to work out a way where most people will be satisfied.”

smiles "thank you.... I agree.... we can work out the details with the people if you believe... but I must ask you both a favor" pauses a moment "... never call our laborers serfs again in my presence.... serf is an insult, and puts them below others..... we are all supposed to be equals here..... they are the ones this town is built on, and deserve better than to be called a short term for servants...."
Copper smiles, he bows his head “I can most easily accommodate that, thank you my friend.”
smiles
